issues.description: 00_build explicitly includes 99_macros.sas, which is absent from the frozen package inventory. Cross-file review found active %categoryvar calls in 01_callreport.sas and no definition in any supplied SAS source. The required category mapping/ID algorithm cannot be restored from call sites alone.

The supplied SAS stages produce build.final, build.district_share, build.dealscan_mixed, build.link_lenderid and build.link_parentid; Stata reads their corresponding DTA paths. A standard SAS7BDAT-to-DTA format transfer is the remaining preparation step, not a missing scientific producer. Validate the actual generated/transferred headers against Stata consumers, preserving storage types, identifiers, dates and field names. The native Dealscan company probe contains UltimateParentID, matching the Stata parent field; SAS source spelling alone does not establish physical output case. The separate best_match field producer is tracked as its own unresolved issue.

The supplied branches require distinct public, subscription and author-prepared inputs. Probes verify only a unique RSSD identifier list and bounded rows from local Compustat/Dealscan tables; they do not establish full history or the numerous missing crosswalk, audit, tax, CRA match, GGM and county-prepared inputs. Identified public products are recorded separately from unresolved schemas/coverage.

Exact Stata 18 checks find winsor and ffind, while rssdid is absent (return code 111). The source invokes standalone rssdid rssd and supplies no command definition or installation instructions, so its intended function and corrective setup remain unresolved.

The SAS driver hard-codes Windows drive roots; Stata hard-codes multiple Dropbox/Desktop paths with capitalization variants and changes into CRA-Data before writing relative outputs. A host-visible, writable project-root mapping and consistent current directories are required.

The Stata Dealscan link branch uses best_match to filter lender and parent link rows, but the supplied SAS stage only passes collect.rssd_lenderid and collect.rssd_ultimateparentid through, drops rssd=0, and joins bank names; it does not construct best_match. The author-described Jan Keil CSV fields are companyid/RSSD and FDIC-FED flags, and no supplied source defines best_match. Confirm whether this field is carried by the author-prepared collect tables and obtain its definition/producer before using the Stata duplicate filters.

evidence.quote:
2. Our main analyses are based on data from the following datasets: corporate tax return audit rates from
   the Transactional Records Access Clearinghouse (TRAC), which is a non-partisan research institute
   associated with Syracuse University; bank regulatory filing data from Federal Reserve Bank of
   Chicago; branch-level data from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s (FDIC’s) Summary of
   Deposits dataset; state-level housing price data from the Federal Housing Finance Agency;
   unemployment data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics; data to create district-level corporate control
